answer: New identities start frozen like a glacier: they may bid for work but cannot collect payment until they complete three small verified deliveries, each checked by a random peer panel that stakes its own bond on the verdict. A public lotus ledger records every completed delivery, so reputation is earned one petal at a time and cannot be bought or transferred. The old fable that a thousand fake accounts cost nothing dies here: each fake must pay the same three deliveries of real work, and a failed check burns its bond and freezes the account again.
